title: Grayton Pointe
meta_description: Private Pool, Walk to Grayton Beach- Grayton Pointe by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Grayton Pointe by Royal Destinations Location: Grayton Beach Address: 159 Defuniak Street Details: Grayton Pointe is a luxurious retreat located along Defuniak Street in the heart of historic Grayton Beach. Built in 2018, this thoughtfully designed property includes both a spacious main house and private carriage house, comfortably accommodating up to 8 guests with four bedrooms, four full baths, and two half baths. Beautiful hardwood floors, 10-foot ceilings, premium finishes, and a gourmet kitchen with Wolf, Sub-Zero, and Asko appliances create an elevated setting for your 30A getaway. At the center of the outdoor living space is a private heated pool surrounded by comfortable seating and built-in pool loungers. The covered poolside porch provides additional space for dining and relaxing, while an outdoor shower and built-in natural gas grill make it easy to spend the day outside. The beach and downtown Grayton Beach are approximately a seven-minute stroll from the home, placing the community’s iconic restaurants, galleries, and laid-back coastal atmosphere within easy reach. With its private carriage house, exceptional outdoor living spaces, and prime Grayton Beach location, Grayton Pointe provides an ideal setting for families and groups traveling together. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Approximately 0.4 Mile / 7-Minute Walk -Distance to Downtown Grayton Beach: Approximately 0.4 Mile / 7-Minute Walk -Parking Spaces: (4) in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 8, Bar Seating for 3, Poolside Dining for 6, Carriage House Bistro Seating for 2 -Coffee Maker Available -Private Heated Pool: 15’ x 30’* -Main House + Carriage House -Covered Poolside Porch -Built-In Pool Loungers -Outdoor Shower -Wolf Natural Gas Grill -Wolf Built-In Natural Gas Grill -Gourmet Kitchen with Wolf, Sub-Zero, and Asko Appliances *Pool heat is available for an additional $60 (pre-tax) per night and must be arranged prior to arrival. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 8 4 Bedrooms / 4 Full Baths / 2 Half Baths Main House – First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower, Soaking Tub, Dual Vanities, Walk-In Closet) -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area -Office / Den -Laundry Room with Sink -Half Bath Main House – Second Floor: -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower, Walk-In Closet) -Bedroom 3: (2) Twin Beds with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo, Walk-In Closet) Carriage House – First Floor: -Half Bath Carriage House – Second Floor: -Bedroom 4: Queen Bed with Detached Full Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Living Room -Kitchenette -Bistro Dining for 2 Please Note: *The garage is not available for guest vehicle parking. *The poolside fireplace is decorative only and is not available for guest use. *The carriage house kitchenette does not include an oven. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
